quote: “But that is the beginning of a new story—the story of the gradual renewal of a man, the story of his gradual regeneration, of his passing from one world into another, of his initiation into a new unknown life.”
source: Fyodor Dostoevsky, Crime and Punishment, Epilogue, chapter 2, the closing paragraph (trans. Constance Garnett, 1914)
